text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion finishes the Arima Kinen. 
Seeing off a lonely-looking Daiwa Scarlet, 
she responds to the cheers with a bright 
and cheerful heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Air Shakur spoke with 
self-deprecating irony. While struggling 
against the outcome preordained by data, 
she had seen hope in Fine Motion...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If only they could prevent her return to 
her home country, there was supposed to be 
a chance to change their own destiny. Yet, 
the outcome remained unchanged. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion saw through to the fact that 
she hadn't given up. She spurred her on, 
saying she had to prove it herself, and 
bid her farewell.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Fine Motion announces her 
return home at a press conference. Tears 
glistened in her eyes...
